name: Rocket.Chat
description: Rocket.Chat is a secure communications platform that unifies messaging, voice, video, and AI within self-hosted, on-premises, or air-gapped deployments for organizations with strict security and data-sovereignty needs.
best_for: Government, defense, critical-infrastructure, and healthcare organizations that require self-hosted or air-gapped messaging with strict data-sovereignty and compliance controls.
features: Unified messaging, voice, video, and screen sharing
Self-hosted, on-premises, and air-gapped deployment options
Zero-trust security model used in classified network environments
GDPR, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and HIPAA compliance
Comprehensive audit logs and data-retention policies
Open, extensible app ecosystem to avoid vendor lock-in
